content.todaysFocus: Today is logistics prep ahead of the 2-month visit, which opens tomorrow. The single highest-leverage move is buffering the next day of feeds so post-vaccine fussiness does not collide with an empty bottle.

actionItems.body: Pre-fill the next 24 hours of breastmilk or formula and stage it in the fridge, since vaccine fussiness reliably disrupts the feeding rhythm for a day or two.
Confirm tomorrow's appointment time and bring a printed question list: sleep-training stance, solids timing, growth percentile trajectory, and when to drop the swaddle.
Stage infant acetaminophen but do not dose before the shots; treat fever after, since pre-dosing can blunt the antibody response.

watchFors: [low concern] Drooling and wet sneezes from salivary-gland maturation, plus occasional hiccups after feeds; none require action.
[monitor] No social smile by eight weeks (Avi is 55 days, just under): note it now and raise it at tomorrow's visit.
[call within 24h] Forceful arching during feeds with painful spit-up, or refusal of multiple feeds in a row.
[call now] Rectal temperature 100.4F (38.0C) or higher, blue lips, labored breathing, or a seizure-like episode; for blue lips call 911 now!

enrichment.body: Sing or play a short Suzuki recording during a calm wake window; early listening exposure builds the perceptual base before formal lessons begin.
Read the same favorite board book aloud to anchor the day with familiar rhythm; predictable repetition is the active ingredient pre-verbally.
Run tummy time as four to six short bouts toward 45 to 60 minutes total, staggered across the day rather than one long session.
Hold him at a mirror for two to three minutes; self-recognition is months away, but the face circuitry is actively calibrating now.

upcoming: Day 56-70 (now open): 2-month well visit. Vaccines due: HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1.
Day 57-72: post-vaccine 24-48h window. Expect fussiness, low-grade fever, and extra sleep.
Day 112-126: 4-month well visit. Vaccines: RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.

content.todaysFocus: Avi is eight weeks old and the 2-month well visit window opens today. This is the most consequential health-care touchpoint since the newborn visit, with six vaccines on the schedule.

actionItems.body: Attend the 2-month visit; vaccines are HepB #2, RV #1, DTaP #1, Hib #1, PCV #1, IPV #1, given as three to four injections plus the oral rotavirus dose.

Remember that any rectal temperature of 100.4F (38.0C) or higher in an infant under 90 days still needs same-day evaluation, even immediately after shots; the pediatrician will not assume it is vaccine-related.
Do not delay this visit much past day 70: the first rotavirus dose must be given by 14 weeks 6 days, about day 104.

watchFors: [low concern] Mild fever at or below 101F rectal, injection-site redness or swelling, fussiness, and extra sleep for 24 to 48 hours; the oral rotavirus dose may cause mild diarrhea.
[monitor] Fever 102 to 104F rectal post-vaccine, persistent crying of one to three hours, or hard injection-site swelling over 2 inches.
[call within 24h] Fever above 104F rectal, inconsolable crying past three hours, or a hypotonic-hyporesponsive episode (limp, pale, unresponsive).

[call now] Anaphylaxis within 30 minutes of a shot (facial swelling, breathing difficulty, hives), a seizure, or any rectal temperature 100.4F (38.0C) or higher under 90 days; for breathing difficulty call 911 now!

enrichment.body: Keep tummy time gentle today; short staggered bouts are fine even on a fussy vaccine day, and skipping a day causes no setback.
Offer slow serve-and-return coo turns when he is calm and alert: respond as if he spoke, pause, then answer his next sound. This turn-taking cadence predicts later language outcomes.
Pair one specific song with each diaper change as a regulation ritual; the predictability matters more than the song.
Keep the room dim and low-stimulation through the evening to help an over-tired, post-shot baby settle.

upcoming: Day 57-72: post-vaccine 24-48h window. Plan for fussiness, low-grade fever, and drowsiness over the next day or two.
Day 84-91: sleep-consolidation window opens near three months; start anchoring a consistent sleep-wake routine.
Day 112-126: 4-month well visit. Vaccines: RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.

content.todaysFocus: Day one of the post-vaccine recovery window. Expect a fussier, sleepier baby for 24 to 48 hours; the job today is comfort, hydration, and weight-based fever management.

actionItems.body: Expect mild fever, fussiness, and extra sleep for 24 to 48 hours; escalate for fever over 102 to 104F rectal or inconsolable crying past three hours.
Dose acetaminophen weight-based per the pediatrician only if he is uncomfortable; treat the fever after the fact, not on a schedule.
Keep offering feeds on demand from yesterday's pre-filled supply, since fussiness can suppress intake for a day.

watchFors: [low concern] Low-grade fever at or below 101F rectal, a tender injection site, more sleep than usual, and mild diarrhea from the rotavirus dose.
[monitor] Fever 102 to 104F rectal lasting beyond 48 hours, or hard injection-site swelling of 2 to 4 inches.
[call within 24h] Inconsolable crying past three hours, a hypotonic-hyporesponsive episode, or injection-site swelling that crosses a joint.
[call now] Rectal temperature 100.4F (38.0C) or higher with lethargy, blue lips, labored breathing, or a seizure; for blue lips or trouble breathing call 911 now!

enrichment.body: Soothe with the same live lullaby you use nightly; a familiar melody aids regulation on a hard day, and the repetition is what helps.
Lean on the lights-out song to ease an extra-sleepy evening into rest, keeping the bedtime sequence identical to other nights.
Offer skin-to-skin chest time rather than structured floor activity today; it supports comfort and lets you skip tummy time without consequence.

upcoming: Day 57-72: you are inside the post-vaccine window now; symptoms should fade within 48 hours.
Day 84-91: sleep-consolidation window opens near three months; begin a consistent sleep-wake routine.
Day 112-126: 4-month well visit. Vaccines: RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.

content.todaysFocus: Day two of post-vaccine recovery, when most symptoms taper. Keep the day low-stimulation and let the established routines do the work while he finishes recovering.

actionItems.body: Keep today low-stimulation with extra skin-to-skin and rest; note that the oral rotavirus dose may still cause mild diarrhea or fussiness for another day.
Continue the AAP-recommended 400 IU/day vitamin D supplement, which is required for exclusively or predominantly breastfed infants regardless of how much daylight he gets.
Track feeds and wet diapers today so you can confirm intake recovered to baseline before resuming normal activity tomorrow.

watchFors: [low concern] Lingering low-grade fussiness 24 to 72 hours post-vaccine and decreasing spit-up volume as the upper esophageal sphincter matures.
[monitor] Asymmetric movement favoring one side, or a persistent head turn to one side suggesting torticollis; flag at the next visit.
[call within 24h] Persistent vomiting unrelated to the vaccines, a noticeable drop in output, or a new feeding-refusal pattern.
[call now] Rectal temperature 100.4F (38.0C) or higher more than 72 hours after the shots, blue lips, or a seizure; for blue lips call 911 now!

enrichment.body: Read quietly from a familiar book to hold the routine steady while he recovers; daily reading from infancy builds the language base that drives later vocabulary.
Offer soft serve-and-return coo turns only when he is alert and calm; back off if he turns away or frets, since over-stimulation is the wrong move today.
Hold him upright on your chest for short stretches; the gentle head-steadying practice counts without a formal floor session.

upcoming: Day 57-72: still inside the post-vaccine window; expect symptoms to resolve by tomorrow.
Day 84-91: sleep-consolidation window opens near three months.
Day 112-126: 4-month well visit. Vaccines: RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.

subject: Day 59: toy just out of reach

content.todaysFocus: The post-vaccine window has closed and the easy stretch begins. With Avi engaging more and reaching emerging, today is about motivating the stretch-and-push toward 60-plus minutes of tummy time.

actionItems.body: Resume full tummy time toward 60-plus minutes per day cumulative, placing a toy just out of reach to motivate stretching and forearm push-ups.
Confirm the 4-month visit and its vaccines are on the calendar: window opens day 112 to 126 with RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.
If returning to work, use this calm stretch for a two-to-four-hour daycare or nanny trial run to test the handoff before leave ends.

watchFors: [low concern] Decreasing spit-up volume and longer alert windows as he engages more with faces and toys.
[monitor] Persistent head turn to one side or a flattening spot (positional plagiocephaly); alternate his resting head side and add prone time.
[call within 24h] Persistent vomiting, a new color change during feeds, or feeding refusal lasting more than 24 hours.
[call now] Rectal temperature 100.4F (38.0C) or higher, blue lips, labored breathing, or sudden limpness; for blue lips or trouble breathing call 911 now!

enrichment.body: Let him track the toy fluidly side to side and up toward the midline as his visual following sharpens at this age.
Take an easy daylight stroller loop now that the vaccine window has passed; outdoor light and varied sensory input support his rhythm and your cardiovascular recovery.
Graduate read-aloud from purely high-contrast pages to a simple narrative or texture book to engage tactile attention alongside the visual.

upcoming: Day 84-91: sleep-consolidation window opens near three months; start a consistent sleep-wake routine.
Day 112-126: 4-month well visit. Vaccines: RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, IPV #2.
Watch for the first laugh in the coming weeks (typical range 10 to 14 weeks).
